_method: Hand-labeled gold set. For each query, 'relevant' lists the policy chunk_id(s) that a human adjudicator would need to read to answer it, determined by reading data/policy_chunks.json. 'evidence_terms' are strings that must appear in at least one relevant chunk; `python eval/retrieval_eval.py --validate-gold` checks this so labeling slips are caught. Group 'pipeline' = the exact search queries the Case Analysis Agent issues; group 'natural' = paraphrases a reviewer might type, deliberately not copying the policy wording. LABELS WERE AUTHORED BY THE DEVELOPER (with AI assistance), NOT by an independent insurance expert; review them before quoting results externally.
